titulo: Who is Ben Carroll, the man who has become Victoria’s new premier?
cuerpo: Carroll, who was elected to parliament in 2012 and says he has always been ambitious, has been sworn in as premier after Jacinta Allan resigned LIVE: Jacinta Allan resigns as premier of Victoria Get our breaking news email , free app or daily news podcast In 2023, when then-public transport minister Ben Carroll failed in his surprising bid to secure the leadership of the Victorian Labor party, he told a press conference: “I was always very keen to rise.” The premier Daniel Andrews had resigned, believing he had locked in his succession plan: his loyal deputy Jacinta Allan as premier , and treasurer Tim Pallas as deputy.
